Load and unload freight using appropriate equipment and machinery, including tailgate lifters, pallet jacks, tipping systems, and forklifts (where appropriately licensed), ensuring all tasks are completed safely and efficiently. Demonstrated commitment to workplace health and safety, safe driving practices, and compliance with company policies and procedures. Weldworks is hiring a Full-time Construction Project Manager role in West Ryde, NSW. Apply now to be part of our team.

Requirements for this role:

Flexible hours available
2–3 years of relevant work experience required for this role
WELDWORKS PTY LTD is looking for an experienced Construction Project Manager for our client’s construction projects, including residential homes, commercial buildings, civil works and public spaces in Sydney.
On a full-time basis, you will be responsible for planning, organising, directing, controlling and coordinating construction projects, as well as managing the physical, financial and human resources involved in the construction process.

Title: Construction Project Manager, Full-time position
Salary: A$ 90,000.00 to 98,000.00 plus super
Work Location: In person
We are looking for applicants who demonstrate the following:

Requirements
•	Bachelor’s degree or higher in Construction Project Management, Construction Management, Building Technology, Building Science, Civil Engineering or another highly relevant field. 
•	At least 2–3 years of relevant experience managing residential, commercial, industrial or civil construction projects. 
•	Demonstrated experience managing construction schedules, budgets, labour, materials, plant and equipment. 
•	Strong knowledge of construction methods, building legislation, Australian Standards, quality requirements and workplace health and safety procedures. 
•	Ability to read, assess and interpret architectural drawings, engineering plans, specifications and construction contracts. 
•	Experience coordinating architects, engineers, consultants, subcontractors, suppliers, tradespeople and relevant authorities. 
•	Strong understanding of tendering, procurement, contract administration and project cost control. 
•	Ability to identify project risks, delays and budget variations and implement appropriate corrective actions. 
•	Strong leadership, communication, negotiation and stakeholder-management skills. 
•	Excellent organisational, reporting and problem-solving abilities. 
•	Current Australian driver licence preferred. 
•	Relevant registration, licence or site accreditation may be required depending on the project and scope of work. 

Construction Project Manager Responsibilities
•	Plan, organise, direct, control and coordinate construction projects from commencement through to completion. 
•	Establish project plans, construction schedules, milestones, budgets and resource requirements. 
•	Interpret architectural drawings, engineering plans, technical specifications and contractual requirements. 
•	Determine appropriate construction methods, sequencing, labour requirements, materials, plant and equipment. 
•	Coordinate the procurement and delivery of construction materials, equipment and services. 
•	Consult with architects, engineers, building professionals, consultants, tradespeople and technical workers. 
•	Negotiate and communicate with building owners, property developers, clients, suppliers and subcontractors. 
•	Prepare, review and contribute to tenders, quotations, contract bids and project proposals. 
•	Implement coordinated work programs across construction sites. 
•	Monitor project progress, expenditure, quality, safety, risk and compliance against approved plans and budgets. 
•	Ensure construction activities comply with relevant building legislation, Australian Standards, contractual requirements and workplace health and safety procedures. 
•	Manage and monitor the performance, quality and progress of contractors and subcontractors. 
•	Arrange the submission of plans, permits and supporting documents to relevant authorities. 
•	Coordinate required inspections, approvals and project handover activities. 
•	Prepare progress reports, budget updates, risk assessments and project documentation. 
•	Identify potential delays, cost overruns, quality issues and construction risks and implement appropriate corrective actions. 
•	Lead and supervise site managers, project engineers, supervisors, forepersons, subcontractors and tradespeople as required. 
•	Maintain effective communication with clients and key stakeholders throughout the construction process. 
•	Ensure projects are completed safely, on time, within budget and in accordance with the required quality standards. 

These responsibilities reflect the official ANZSCO functions for Construction Project Managers, including management of construction 
schedules, procurement, contractors, budgets, compliance, inspections and project resources. 
If you would like to discuss the role further, please click APPLY and send through an up-to-date CV. We can schedule a time to discuss the position available and determine whether the role is suitable for your qualifications and experience.
Work Location: In person

## Technical Writer

## Position Overview

We are looking for a skilled and detail-oriented Technical Writer to join our team and produce clear, accurate, and user-friendly documentation that supports both internal operations and end-user understanding. This role is central to bridging the gap between complex technical concepts and accessible written content across a range of formats and platforms. The ideal candidate will bring strong research capabilities, excellent written communication skills, and the ability to collaborate effectively with subject matter experts, developers, and stakeholders. A background in a technical discipline combined with a passion for clear communication would make you an exceptional fit for this position.

## Key Responsibilities

- Research, develop, and maintain a broad range of technical documentation including user manuals, handbooks, training materials, standard operating procedures, and multimedia content

- Translate complex technical information into clear, concise, and accurate content tailored to the intended audience, whether end users, internal teams, or stakeholders

- Collaborate closely with engineers, developers, product managers, and subject matter experts to gather information and verify technical accuracy across all documentation

- Plan, organise, and manage documentation projects from initial brief through to final publication, ensuring deadlines and quality standards are consistently met

- Review and edit existing documentation to identify gaps, inconsistencies, or outdated content, and update materials to reflect product or process changes

- Develop and apply style guides, templates, and documentation standards to ensure consistency in tone, format, and terminology across all written outputs

- Produce content for digital and print formats including online help systems, knowledge bases, e-learning modules, and technical reference guides

- Liaise with stakeholders to understand documentation requirements and translate business or technical briefs into structured, reader-focused content

- Conduct quality assurance reviews of documentation prior to release, checking for technical accuracy, readability, grammar, and adherence to brand and style guidelines

- Support the development of training materials and contribute to onboarding programmes by producing clear instructional content for new users or staff

- Manage version control and document repositories, ensuring all materials are correctly filed, versioned, and accessible to relevant teams

## Required Qualifications & Skills

- Bachelor's degree in English, Communications, Technical Writing, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline

- Demonstrated experience in a technical writing role, ideally within a corporate, technology, or engineering environment

- Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with a high level of attention to detail and accuracy

- Proven ability to research, interpret, and document complex technical subjects in a clear and accessible manner

- Proficiency in documentation tools such as MadCap Flare, Confluence, Microsoft Word, or equivalent platforms

- Experience working with content management systems, version control tools, and document repositories

- Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and meet tight deadlines

- Ability to work collaboratively across cross-functional teams and build effective relationships with technical and non-technical stakeholders

- Sound understanding of documentation best practices, including the use of style guides such as the Microsoft Manual of Style or equivalent

## Preferred Qualifications

- Postgraduate qualification or professional certification in Technical Communication, such as a Certificate IV in Professional Writing and Editing or equivalent

- Experience with API documentation, software development lifecycle (SDLC), or working within Agile project environments

- Familiarity with graphic design or multimedia tools such as Adobe Illustrator, Snagit, or Camtasia to support visual documentation

- Exposure to single-sourcing methodologies and structured authoring frameworks such as DITA

- Prior experience in a regulated industry such as healthcare, finance, or engineering where documentation compliance is essential

## Why Join Us?

- Flexible working arrangements including hybrid and remote options to support a healthy work-life balance

- A collaborative, inclusive team culture that values expertise, continuous learning, and professional growth

- Access to ongoing training, professional development programmes, and support for further education or industry certifications

- Meaningful work that directly contributes to product quality, customer experience, and organisational knowledge

- Competitive remuneration package with additional benefits reviewed annually in line with performance

## Job Details

- Job Type: Full-time, Permanent

- Work Schedule: 8-hour shift

- Salary: $70,000 – $120,000 per year + Super

Job Position : System Analyst
Location: Parramatta NSW 2150
Company: Discount Building Material Pty Ltd
Salary: $79,000 – $89,000 per annum
Employment Type: Full-Time, Permanent

About Us
Discount Building Material Pty Ltd, located in Parramatta NSW 2150, is an Australian technology-driven building materials platform connecting leading manufacturers with a nationwide network of resellers. Through a single digital portal, the company streamlines wholesale ordering, delivers accurate product information, and enables seamless supplier integration to improve procurement efficiency across the building materials industry.

Key Duties
• Consult with business stakeholders to gather, analyse, and document business and system requirements for ICT solutions.
• Review existing information systems, business processes, and workflows to identify
opportunities for improved functionality, efficiency, and performance.
• Prepare functional specifications, process models, workflow diagrams, and technical
documentation to support system development and implementation.
• Evaluate and recommend system enhancements and ICT solutions that align with business objectives and operational requirements.
• Collaborate with software developers, project managers, and external service providers throughout the design, development, and implementation of business systems.
• Coordinate system testing activities, validate business requirements, and ensure
implemented solutions satisfy functional and operational expectations.
• Monitor system performance, investigate system issues, and recommend continuous
improvements to optimise reliability and business outcomes.
• Develop user documentation, provide implementation support, and assist with user training to promote effective adoption of new and enhanced systems.

Skills, Qualifications & Experience
• Bachelor's degree or higher qualification in Information Technology, Information Systems, Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a closely related discipline.
• A minimum of one (1) year of relevant post-qualification experience in systems analysis, business analysis, information systems, or a related field.
• Demonstrated experience in analysing business requirements, evaluating ICT systems, preparing functional specifications, and supporting the delivery of system solutions.
• Sound knowledge of systems analysis methodologies, business process modelling, systems integration, software development life cycle (SDLC), and system testing practices.
• Strong analytical, communication, problem-solving, and stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively within multidisciplinary project teams.

What We Offer
• Competitive annual salary, based on qualifications and experience.
• Opportunity to work on innovative business systems and digital transformation projects.
• Ongoing professional development and career progression opportunities.
• Supportive, collaborative, and technology-focused workplace.
• Stable employment opportunity with a growing Australian business.

How to Apply
If you are an experienced System Analyst with a passion for improving business systems and delivering effective solutions, we encourage you to apply.

Full job description 

We are seeking a highly skilled Solution Architect with proven expertise in Ezy-Serve, Change-Ezy SaaS and SAP solutions. The ideal candidate must have led end-to-end implementation of Ezy-Serve SaaS solution with integration to SAP S/4 HANA. Web Application, mobile application development, architecture, and deployment in Field Service Mobility Solutions. This role requires extensive customer engagement, technical solutioning, and ongoing support to ensure seamless adoption and optimization of the SaaS platform. 

Key Responsibilities: 

Architect, develop, and optimize the Ezy-Serve, Service Delivery platform and Ezy-Day mobile applications for iOS and Android. 

Own the full software lifecycle from conceptualization to go-live for Ezy-Serve mobility solutions. 

Drive the next-gen evolution of Ezy-Serve and Ezy-Day, enhancing performance, security, and scalability. 

Ensure seamless backend integration of Ezy-Day and the Ezy-Serve platform using RESTful services with SAP S/4 HANA, SAP GEF and integration with ESRI ArcGIS. 

Provide technical leadership to a team of developers, mentoring them on mobile app best practices. 

Drive implementation of SAP GEF on S/4 HANA integration with ESRI ArcGIS. 

Develop offline-capable mobile applications with advanced GIS integrations, including ESRI, SAP GEF, Mapbox, and OpenStreetMap. 

Act as a primary liaison for enterprise customers, ensuring successful implementation, troubleshooting, and support. 

Conduct customer engagement workshops to gather requirements, provide demonstrations, and ensure seamless onboarding of SaaS solutions. 

Collaborate with customer IT teams to align Ezy-Serve SaaS solutions with existing enterprise applications. 

Monitor and support customer deployments, ensuring high availability, proactive issue resolution, and continual improvements. 

Spearhead mobile app security using authentication, encryption, and data protection best practices. 

Manage the scalability and performance optimization of Ezy-Serve and mobility solutions for large enterprise customers. 

 

 

Mandatory Requirements: 

Hands-on experience in Ezy-Serve and Change-Ezy SaaS products, with multiple deployments. 

Proficiency in Android (Java), iOS (Swift), Angular WebApplication, and Restful Integration for enterprise field mobility applications. 

Strong experience in GIS mapping solutions within Ezy-Serve, S/4 HANA, Ezy-Day and ESRI ArcGIS. 

Expertise in Spring Boot, REST APIs, Kafka, PostgreSQL, and microservices architecture. 

Experience in customer support, implementation, and SaaS product maintenance. 

Proven track record of integrating mobile apps with ERP and enterprise systems. 

Experience leading cross-functional teams, including backend, frontend, and cloud engineers. 

Excellent customer relationship management and communication skills. 

Experience in IoT-driven FSM applications. 

Hands-on experience with SAP integrations for Ezy-Serve solutions. 

Strong knowledge of serverless architectures, AWS, and cloud-native technologies. 

Must have hands on experience in Ezy -Serve solutions and high-traffic FSM solutions with thousands of active users. 

This role is open only to candidates with experience working on Ezy-Serve. Candidates with experience in Ezy-Serve or Change-Ezy solutions are needed. 

Job Type: Full-time 

Pay: $75,000.00 – $90,000.00 per year 

Education: 

Bachelor Degree (mandatory) 

Experience: 

IT: 9+ years (Required) 

SAP integrations for Ezy-Serve solutions: 7+ years (Required)

MedicalJobsAustralia.com     Power BI Developer | BlueCare | Community Performance & Enablement

Employment Term: Fixed term Full Time Contract - 6 months

Located in: Hybrid Brisbane or Toowoomba

Remuneration: Base salary + 12% Super + Not For Profit Salary Packaging + Staff discounts

Reporting to the Reporting and Performance Lead the Power BI Analyst will lead the development of reporting solutions that address both immediate business needs and lay the foundation for long-term performance measurement.

You will be accountable for operationalising performance reporting processes across Blue Care's Community Services, covering both financial and non-financial outcomes, including operational, quality, customer, and workforce metrics. You will also be responsible for analysing service performance, identifying improvement opportunities, and delivering practical, data-driven recommendations to enhance outcomes.

About the Role

Delivery of timely, accurate and appropriate business performance reporting solutions to enable strategic level decision making whilst managing security to data at all times

Proactively lead and implement solutions to address data quality-integrity using the tool suites available or being implemented

Proactively lead and develop user requirements, functional specifications with associated timeline commitments to appropriately manage stakeholder expectations

Manage multiple projects simultaneously and execute in a high-pressure environment

Contribute to the maximisation of synergies across BlueCare as a single integrated organisation to improve outcomes for our customers

Actively lead in requirements gathering participate with various stakeholders and implement agreed plans

Actively participate in the design, redesign or development of data solutions to support Business Intelligence solutions

Design, code, test and document new or modifications to reports

Role Requirements

Minimum of 2 years of experience in developing Power BI reports

Experience in data interrogation, business analysis and report writing-creation, business - process improvements

Enterprise Architecture frameworks and the use of Informatica and data lake-data warehouses

Exceptional analytical, conceptual, and problem-solving experience considering the holistic organisational impacts

Demonstrated skills in Power BI, data gateways and design solutions

Has experience or has lead data model development or business process modelling

Strong understanding of relational database structures, theories, principles and practices

Experience with formal systems development and testing methods

Employee Benefits: 

Save tax and increase your take home pay by salary packaging your everyday living expenses and bills (up to $15,900) and meal entertainment (up to $2,650) per annum 

A recognition and rewards platform, providing employee discounts at hundreds of retailers, including everyday expenses, holidays, health insurance, annual awards celebration, wellbeing and employee assistance programs 

12 weeks paid parental leave and 2 weeks paid partner leave, available after 6 months service, in addition to the government scheme 

Diversity and inclusive leave, offering paid gender affirmation leave and cultural leave options (paid and unpaid) for those who may celebrate Lunar New Year, Diwali, Ramadan, NAIDOC weeks and other significant cultural events 

Career development opportunities with one of the most trusted community and residential care providers in Australia to challenge yourself, grow and make a meaningful difference 

BlueCare is proudly part of the UnitingCare Family, we'd love you to be too

Joining the state's largest network of aged care workers with its over 8,000 strong, bright team in blue, you'll also be welcomed as part of the UnitingCare family. With more than 16,500 staff and 9,000 volunteers across our brands of BlueCare, Lifeline, ARRCS, The Wesley Hospital, Buderim Private Hospital, St Stephen's Hospital, and St Andrew's War Memorial Hospital, you are part of something bigger. Our team are compassionate, inclusive and committed to the work we do, helping people live life in all its fullness.

Child safe, Child friendly 

UnitingCare is committed to being a Child Safe, Child Friendly organisation and will: 

Provide welcoming, safe & nurturing services for children 

Implement measures to prevent child abuse and neglect within our services

Appropriately and immediately address child abuse and neglect if it does occur 

Abide by the Child Safe Standards and adhere to the Reportable Conduct Scheme 

Diversity & Inclusion 

Our approach is simple -everybody is welcome here. At UnitingCare, diversity is at the core of our who we are, our mission and our values. We are committed to providing equal opportunities to all employees no matter their sex, race, culture, sexual orientation, disability or gender identity. Demonstrating our commitment to reconciliation and building long-term employment opportunities for First Nations peoples, UnitingCare strongly encourages Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander applicants for this position. For additional support and to meet our RAP Team, email reconciliation@ucareqld.com.au

Safe workplace 

We work hard to make our services welcoming and safe for every person. We are united in keeping children, young people and the elderly safe from harm, within our services, workplaces and the communities we support. We are committed to speaking up loudly for their safety.

Commitment to Safeguarding

We are committed in creating services and workplaces that are welcoming and safe for every person. We work together to protect children, young people, adults and the elderly from harm within our services and the communities we support. We speak up for their safety to ensure their voices are heard. Our recruitment and workplace practices reflect our dedication in preventing abuse, harm and exploitation across UnitingCare.    Click here to Apply now →
